xna-type.name: Playlist
xna-type.summary: Provides access to a playlist in the media library.
xna-type.remarks: The Playlist class provides information about a playlist, including the playlist's Name , Duration , and Songs . Obtain Playlist objects through the PlaylistCollection.Item indexer.

property.name: Duration
property.summary: Gets the duration of the Playlist.

property.name: IsDisposed
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the object is disposed.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Gets the name of the Playlist.

property.name: Songs
property.summary: Gets a SongCollection that contains the songs in the playlist.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

method.summary: Determines whether the specified Object is equal to this Playlist.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Object is equal to this Playlist.

parameters.parameter: Object to compare with this instance.

overload.returns: true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

overload.summary: Determines whether the specified Playlist is equal to this Playlist.

parameters.parameter: Playlist to compare with this instance.

overload.returns: true if the objects are equal; false otherwise.

method.name: Finalize
method.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Playlist is reclaimed by garbage collection.

overload.summary: Releases unmanaged resources and performs other cleanup operations before the Playlist is reclaimed by garbage collection.
overload.remarks: This method overrides Finalize System.Object.Finalize . Application code should not call this method. The object's Finalize method is automatically invoked during garbage collection, unless a call to the GC.SuppressFinalize method has disabled finalization by the garbage collector. For more information, see Finalize Methods and Destructors , Cleaning Up Unmanaged Resources , and Overriding the Finalize Method .
